messages:
Samir Khan: Quick UX sync — noticed multiple small mismatches between the console UI and the in-product help panel for Routes. Users are getting tripped up when sharing links and using keyboard navigation.
Hannah Lee: can you list the top ones?
Samir Khan: sure: 1) permalink formats differ (console uses fragment ids, docs use query params). 2) the help panel CTA text differs from the main button ("Open docs" vs "View guidance"). 3) the panel isn't keyboard-focusable on mobile-web, and focus trap behaves oddly on desktop with screen readers. Also some translated strings in FR/DE don't match the English label choices.
Priya Singh: yikes. the permalink thing seems most impactful. example of current links:
```
Console fragment: https://console.redwood.ai/route/xyz#variant-panel
Docs canonical: https://docs.redwood.ai/guides/routes?routeId=xyz&section=variant
```
Priya Singh: recommendation: standardize on the docs canonical pattern (query params + section) and make the console copy a redirect/permalink that points there. That keeps external sharing stable.
Elliot Zhang: agree. from engineering POV easier to add a small redirect layer and export a "Copy canonical link" action in the flyout. Also will need to update the mobile web client to generate the same URL.
Hannah Lee: accessibility: screenreader users reported that when the panel opens, focus lands on the close button and not the panel heading; also the "Open docs" control reads only "button" — needs an aria-label.
Samir Khan: for translations, the FR strings currently translate "Model variant" as "Variante de service" which leans toward 'serving' language, while docs use "Variante de modèle". That creates confusion in localized UX.
Priya Singh: let's pick canonical English terms first, then sync i18n. Proposal: use "Model variant" (for the model selection) and "Tier" (for resource sizing). Keep phrases short for mobile.
Elliot Zhang: action items I'd take: 1) add redirect and canonical link API (Eng Infra) 2) add "Copy canonical link" and ensure deep-link opens correct docs section (Eng-UI) 3) fix keyboard focus order + aria-labels (Eng-UI) 4) update docs examples & i18n keys (Docs) 5) update translations for FR/DE and run screen check (Localization).
Hannah Lee: I'll own final copy decisions for the UI strings and run a tiny PM poll. Want to ensure we don't break existing signals in product tours.
Priya Singh: Docs will add the canonical URL snippet and a short paragraph on linking best-practices. I'll include examples for email, Slack, and deep links for mobile. Example canonical link we will document:
```
https://docs.redwood.ai/guides/routes?routeId=xyz&section=variant
```
Priya Singh: also adding a short aria-label suggestion for the button: aria-label="Open docs for this route (opens help panel)"
Elliot Zhang: timeline: I can ship the redirect + Copy link button in 5 business days. Accessibility fixes will be a separate PR (2-3 days). Mobile web change may need a small release alignment.
Hannah Lee: please also check keyboard shortcut help: we have an undocumented Shift+D shortcut that opens help; the docs panel should surface that shortcut in the header once we stabilize naming.
Samir Khan: good catch. let's surface shortcuts and ensure their labels localize.
docs-bot: Shared KB draft: https://docs.redwood.ai/internal/kb/console-linking-permalinks (private). I'll update once Docs posts the public guide.
Priya Singh: I'll post the first draft of the docs + permalink examples by Wed. Hannah, ping me when you have the lexicon choice and I'll update i18n keys.
Hannah Lee: will run the lexicon poll now and share results here. Aim to finalize by EOD Monday.
Elliot Zhang: tagging action owners in our tracker: ENG-UI #4532 (copy + focus), ENG-INFRA #4578 (redirect), DOCS #4610 (permalink + examples), L10N #4622 (translations).
Samir Khan: thanks all. small coordination but should cut several support threads and make shareable links predictable. Drop any further mismatches (quota/limit phrasing etc.) into this thread and we'll batch them into the doc PR. :sparkles:
